description_en: You can call the CreateDcdnSubTask operation to customize operations reports
name: CreateDcdnSubTask

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the reports that you want to customize. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,). Valid values:

2: Top URLs sorted by number of requests.
4: Top URLs sorted by traffic.
6: Top referers sorted by number of requests.
8: Top referers sorted by traffic.
10: Top back-to-origin URLs sorted by number of requests.
12: Top back-to-origin URLs sorted by traffic.
14: Top client IP addresses sorted by number of requests.
16: Top client IP addresses sorted by traffic.
18: Top domain names sorted by traffic.
20: Page views (PVs) and unique visitors (UVs).
22: Distribution of client locations.
24: Distribution of carriers.
26: Peak bandwidth for IPv4 and IPv6.
27: Back-to-origin bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
支持定制的报表ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：
2：热门URL（按请求数排序）。
4：热门URL（按流量排序）。
6：热门Referer（按请求数排序）。
8：热门Referer（按流量排序）。
10：回源热门URL（按请求数排序）。
12：回源热门URL（按流量排序）。
14：Top客户端IP（按请求数排序）。
16：Top客户端IP（按流量排序）。
18：域名排行（按流量排序）。
20：PV和UV。
22：访问区域分布。
24：运营商分布。
26：IPv4/IPv6峰值带宽。
27：回源带宽
parameters.name: report_ids

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

The domain names that you want to subscribe to. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). You can specify a maximum of 500 domain names. To subscribe to more than 500 domain names, submit an application (https://page.aliyun.com/form/act2017566026/index.htm).

</props>

<props="intl">

The domain names for which you want to subscribe to reports. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names at a time. To add more than 500 domain names, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520001.aliyun_topbar.18.dbd44bd3e4f845#/ticket/createIndex).

</props>

If you do not specify this parameter, reports for all domain names under your account are subscribed to by default
